provenance_note: Only ALT allele in dbSNP b157. Manuscript 'A>T' is the same substitution written in GHSR (minus-strand) orientation.
Only ALT allele in dbSNP b157. Manuscript 'G>A' matches the plus-strand (reference-genome) orientation.
dbSNP b157 ALT #1 of a tri-allelic site (T>C, T>G). The manuscript's 'C>T' assigns C as wild type, but GRCh38 carries T; REF/ALT are therefore inverted in the manuscript notation.

dbSNP b157 ALT #2 and the only rs34136054 alternate allele segregating appreciably in gnomAD v4 (global AF 0.005). Analysed as a sensitivity analysis because the manuscript's notation does not identify which alternate allele was observed.
